title: uvifera longifolia

It has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Uvifera longifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, terpenoids, and saponins, that exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic activities. Furthermore, the bioactive compounds present in this plant, such as anonaine and isocorydine, have been studied for their potential in treating various diseases, highlighting the plant's value in traditional medicine.
